name: Hobby Heresy Carry Case
description:
Forged in defiance. 

Built for war.The latest creation from Hobby Heresy Games is here — a battle-hardened miniature storage case forged for the war-torn tabletop. Built with unholy precision and a touch of beautiful blasphemy, this is more than a box — it’s a relic of rebellion.


Contents:
1x Hobby Heresy Carry Case

5x Metal Trays

1x Strap

100x N95 Magnets
